subject: Darunia's Room
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the carpet in front of the sealed door on Goron City's lowest level opens the door.

evidence.quote: Jump down to Goron City's lowest level.  Look for the sealed door with the carpeting in front of it.  Stand on the carpet, and play Zelda's Lullaby to make the door open.

subject: Darunia
text: Playing Saria's Song while standing directly in front of Darunia cheers him up.

evidence.quote: Play Saria's Song while standing directly in front of him to cheer him up.

subject: Darunia
text: Darunia gives Link the Goron's Bracelet, which allows Link to pick up and use Bomb Flowers.

evidence.quote: He'll give you the Goron's Bracelet to help, which can be used to pick up and use Bomb Flowers that grow around Death Mountain.

subject: Giant Pot
text: Lighting all the braziers on the bottom level of Goron City with a flaming Deku Stick causes the giant pot in the middle of the room to begin spinning.

evidence.quote: Use the flame to light all of the braziers on the bottom level of Goron City.  Once all the braziers are lit, then the giant pot in the middle of the room will begin spinning.

subject: Goron City Shop
text: Igniting the Bomb Flowers near the sealed room with a lit Deku Stick blows open the wall to access the Goron City Shop.

evidence.quote: You can also use the lit Deku Stick to ignite the Bomb Flowers near the sealed up room, which will blow open the wall and let you access the Goron City Shop (not that it has anything of real value to buy... yet).

subject: Goron City Second Level
text: Climbing the stairs between the yellow-striped posts leads to the second level, where dropping a Bomb Flower near the boulders clears the tunnel path.

evidence.quote: Head up the stairs between the pair of yellow-striped posts to reach the second level of Goron City.  Run to the right, where you will find two unlit torched and a Goron sitting in front of a tunnel.  Run down this tunnel to see a long line of boulders surrounded by Bomb Flowers.  Pick up one of the Bomb Flowers, and drop it near the boulders to clear a path.

subject: Lost Woods Clearing
text: Going left through the tunnel, then left again, and left one final time leads to a dead-end clearing.

evidence.quote: Go left through the tunnel, then left again, then left one final time.  You'll be in a small clearing which is a dead end.

subject: Soft Earth
text: Releasing bottled bugs near the patch of soft earth by the right Business Scrub reveals a Gold Skulltula that yields a token.

evidence.quote: Release your Bottled Bugs near the patch of soft earth, and recapture one of the bugs before they all disappear.  Kill the Gold Skulltula who emerges from the patch, and take its token.

subject: Invisible Pit
text: Dropping into the invisible pit surrounded by butterflies near the large tree in the clearing leads to the Forest Stage.

evidence.quote: Now, run to the large tree in the back of the clearing, and look for a cluster of butterflies in the tall grass.  These butterflies are actually gathered around an invisible pit.  Drop down into the pit to reach the Forest Stage.

subject: Deku Scrub Chief
text: Wearing the Skull Mask in the Forest Stage prompts the Deku Scrub Chief to increase Link's Deku Stick capacity by 10.

evidence.quote: Put on the Skull Mask and take a few steps forward.  The Deku Scrubs in the stage will begin to cheer and mob you.  Run over to the right side of the room (facing from the entrance), and the Deku Scrub Chief will increase the number of Deku Sticks you can carry by 10.

subject: Forest Stage Clearing
text: Leaving the clearing through the log tunnel and going right, right, left, right, forward, and forward leads back to the Lone Skullkid.

evidence.quote: Leave the clearing through the log tunnel, then go right, right again, and then left.  Hang a right, then forward, and forward again.  You'll find yourself back by the Lone Skullkid.

subject: Lone Skullkid
text: Speaking to the Lone Skullkid while wearing the Skull Mask allows Link to sell the mask to him.

evidence.quote: Otherwise, speak to him while wearing the Skull Mask, and he'll buy it from you.  Unfortunately, he'll buy it from you for less then it's worth, so you're going to have to pay the difference next time you're in town.

subject: Soft Earth
text: Dropping a bottled bug into the soft earth patch at the cliff edge through the log tunnel behind the Skullkid reveals a Gold Skulltula that yields a token.

evidence.quote: Once you have sold the Skull Mask, enter the mouth of the log tunnel behind you.  At the edge of the cliff on the other side is another patch of soft earth.  Drop a Bottled Bug into the patch (remember to recapture one of the three bugs that pops out), and kill the Gold Skulltula who emerges from the earth.  Take it's token.

subject: Goron City Top Floor
text: Ascending the stairs between the red-striped posts on the second level and going right leads to the top floor, where taking two rights exits to Death Mountain Trail.

evidence.quote: Back on the second level of Goron City, go to the far left of the ledge and go up the stairs between the pair of red-striped posts.  When the stairs split left and right, go right.  At the top of the stairs, you'll find yourself on Goron City's top floor.  Go right from the stairwell exit, then right again the first chance you get to return to Death Mountain Trail.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern Entrance
text: Throwing a Bomb Flower from the alcove cliff so that it lands near the blocking boulder opens Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Go around the corner to the right, where there is a small alcove with a Bomb Flower in it.  Pick up the Bomb Flower, and throw it off the cliff so that it lands on or near the boulder blocking Dodongo's Cavern.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern Cliff
text: Backflipping over the fence while running backward toward the cliff edge lands Link on the cliff above Dodongo's Cavern to collect a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Run backwards towards the edge of the cliff, and when you reach the fence, hold back and press A to backflip over the fence.  If you do it just right, then you'll land on the cliff above Dodongo's Cavern and be able to get the Piece of Heart.

subject: Soft Earth
text: Dropping a bug into the soft earth patch outside the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern reveals a Gold Skulltula that yields a token.

evidence.quote: Drop down from the cliff, and enter the mouth of Dodongo's Cavern.  Stop to drop a bug in the patch of soft earth (remember to recapture one of the three who comes out), and kill the Gold Skulltula who emerges.  Take the Token, then enter Dodongo's Cavern.

subject: Cracked Wall
text: Throwing a Bomb Flower near the cracked wall destroys the wall and reveals the main antechamber of Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Grab one of the Bomb Flowers to your right, and throw it near the cracked wall.  The explosion will destroy the wall, revealing Dodongo's Cavern.

subject: Beamos
text: Throwing a Bomb Flower so that it strikes a Beamos on the head causes the Beamos to explode.

evidence.quote: Grab the bomb flower in front of the large window, and quickly Z-target the Beamos enemy to the right of the Bomb Flower.  Run at the Beamos, and throw the Bomb Flower at it.  If you do it right, then the Bomb Flower should strike the Beamos on the head and cause the whole apparatus to explode.

subject: Sealed Wall
text: Blowing open the sealed wall to the right of the Beamos with a Bomb Flower reveals a darkened tunnel leading to the next room.

evidence.quote: Grab another Bomb Flower and use it to blow open the sealed wall to the right of the Beamos.  Go through the darkened tunnel to the next room.

subject: Sealed Barrier
text: Killing a Baby Dodongo as it passes by the sealed wall destroys the barrier with its explosion, granting access to the door.

evidence.quote: You will come to a place where another Baby Dodongo appears, as well as a sealed up wall.  Stand next to the sealed up wall, and then kill the Baby Dodongo as it moves by it.  The explosion will destroy the barrier, letting you access the door on the other side.

subject: Keese
text: Keese that pass through torch flames catch fire, but their attacks can be blocked and their flames doused with the Hylian Shield.

evidence.quote: Watch out though; if they fly through the flame of the torch, they will catch on fire and deal additional damage (and also destroy your Deku Shield if you are still using it).  Use the Hylian Shield to absorb their attacks and douse the flame.

subject: Torch Room Wall
text: Killing the Gold Skulltula on the wall of the Torch Room yields a token that may require a backflip to reach.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall, take the token (you may need to use a backflip to reach it), and return to the Lower Southeast Hall.

subject: Gray Switch
text: Pushing an Armos statue onto the gray switch unlocks the door in the Lower Southeast Hall.

evidence.quote: Grab hold of one of the Armos Statues, and push it into place onto the gray switch.  This will unlock the door.

subject: Keese
text: Keese on either side of the Southeast Passage can be targeted and killed with the Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Z-target the Keese on either side of the room and kill them with the Slingshot.

subject: Lizalfos
text: Lizalfos attacks can be blocked using the shield, followed by an immediate sword counterattack.

evidence.quote: Luckily, all of their attacks are easily blocked using the Turtle Shield technique.  After they've attacked, quickly swing out with your sword.

subject: Lizalfos Nest
text: Defeating both Lizalfos in the nest unlocks the exit door on the west side of the room.

evidence.quote: After the Lizalfos are dead, the door on the west side of the room will unlock.  Go through it.
